title: Biogas - Composition
description: Typical composition of biogas produced from household waste through anaerobic digestion of organic resources such as crops, manure, sewage, municipal waste, green waste, and plant material.

components.content:
## About Biogas

Biogas can be produced from many organic resources through anaerobic (without oxygen) digestion with anaerobic bacteria or by fermentation of biodegradable materials such as:

- Crops
- Manure
- Sewage
- Municipal waste
- Green waste
- Plant material

## Energy Applications

The energy released by combustion of the methane, hydrogen, and carbon monoxide (CO) in the biogas can be used for:

- Heating purposes
- Gas engines to produce electricity
- Powering motor vehicles (as compressed biogas)
